**Milestone:** 0 · Foundations · **Priority:** P1 · **Size:** M · **Epic:** Project setup & tooling › App scaffold and CI

## What to build
Create the web app in this repo: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript strict, ESLint, the database client, and npm scripts `dev`, `build`, `start`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `test`, `db:migrate`, `db:seed`. Folder layout: `src/app` (routes), `src/components` (UI), `src/server` (server-only logic), `src/lib` (shared helpers), `prisma/`, `tests/`.

## Why
Every other task builds on this. Agents need a known layout so they put code in the same places.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `npm run dev` shows a placeholder home page
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `typecheck`, `test`, `build` all pass on a clean clone
- [ ] `.env.example` lists every variable with a comment; the app fails fast with a clear message if one is missing
- [ ] README “Run it locally” section added (3–5 steps)
- [ ] Folder layout documented in a short `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`

## What if…
- [ ] What if the database isn’t running? `npm run dev` prints how to start it instead of a stack trace
- [ ] What if someone uses a different Node version? `engines` + `.nvmrc` pin it

## Done when (every task)
- [ ] Unit tests cover the main path and every “What if…” above
- [ ] lint, typecheck, test and build all pass

## Notes
Port `package.json` scripts, ESLint config and tsconfig from `willimobro/Trade-Marketplace` (Next 15, React 19, Prisma, zod, jose, bcryptjs). Switch the database to whatever **Decide: hosting and database** chooses.
